representation: Keep the round-3 single-scalar carrier for an unpaired unit (U+10F800 + (u - 0xD800)), and make it unambiguous by escaping every legitimate scalar of the reserved set R = U+10F7FF..U+10FFFF as the two scalars ESCAPE (U+10F7FF) + itself. Decoding (java_utf16::tokens): ESCAPE x is the literal x; a carrier not consumed by ESCAPE is the unpaired unit; everything else is itself. Escaping happens exactly once where text enters: PreprocessContext::process (main source, !include, stdlib, !theme), !includesub file text, %getenv and %dirpath values, parse_yaml/parse_json/JSON-data input. java_utf16::text (units to text: Value::from_utf16, to_display, normalize) escapes decoded R scalars, so no internal producer creates an unescaped R scalar. Text without R scalars is byte-identical to before, and an unpaired unit is still one scalar, so every round-3 per-character rule (export, one-em width, TIM boundary letter: both ESCAPE and the carrier have len_utf16 2, like Java's surrogate units) is unchanged.
consumers: java_utf16::units (TIM %strlen/%substr/%upper/compare, svg_id_seed_prefix, filter_registry::plantuml_seed): ESCAPE x contributes x's units.
svg_export::serialize: ESCAPE (raw or &#N;) is removed and the following scalar is ordinary character data; carriers keep the round-3 ToStream rule.
svg::comment_text: ESCAPE writes nothing; the escaped scalar writes one '?' (StreamEncoder REPLACE per code point).
plantuml_metrics::text_width: for text containing ESCAPE, measure tokens: unpaired unit one em (round 3), escaped literal by its own advance.

--ast/--yaml: when the model carries R scalars, render a decoded copy (serde_yml::Value round trip): escapes removed, unpaired units as U+FFFD (Rust's lossy UTF-16 convention; Java has no such output).
-ttxt: render_ascii over a decoded copy with unpaired units as '?' (one cell, UGraphicTxt/StreamEncoder).

-tpng/-tpdf/-teps: the document before export with escapes removed and unpaired units as U+FFFD, never the ToStream failure; outcome exit 0 for PNG/EPS (Java draws the text). PDF: decided from the relayed Java reference.
